value.text: The declared Places POST /places 200 JSON schema requires id. The shown handler returns the selected Place through Ok(city), after awaited Save; Place.Id to JSON.id is the source interpretation of this representation. Dashboard parses and forwards the whole body. The browser checks response.ok without reading these returned Place properties. Actual wire conformance is unverified. Request cityId chooses the Place; the returned id identifies that Place. The separately generated outbox event id is not this field.
